regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows a broad (8/16 eligible) but shallow leadership structure — Oil & Gas is the clear rank-1 theme (score 2.24, breadth 0.929) with Big Banks a distant challenger (0.847), yet 2/3 of the eligible universe is not one-narrative (one_narrative=false). Only the absolute-trend gate has validated edge here; momentum rank is an attention lens and hit rate is 0.598 with weak directional accuracy (0.316), so leans should be conservative. Gold/Silver/Base Metals are ineligible (mean-revert/mixed, low breadth) — a meaningful no-view cluster.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Pipelines & Midstream (ca_pipelines, unscorable, rank 3, breadth 1.0, durability 0.77, trend-tagged) sustains its perfect breadth and trend health relative to Oil & Gas's crowding flag — a widening durability gap with Oil & Gas while remaining eligible would signal a leadership handoff within the Energy complex. The condition that retires this watch: Pipelines' breadth drops below 0.8 or its durability_bar falls below 0.7.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the clear leader with strong breadth (0.929) and eligibility under the trend gate, suggesting staying power even though crowding_z (1.18) flags it as crowded. evidence: eligible=true under absolute-trend gate (the one validated edge)
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is reflexive and can reverse sharply on WTI price shocks; the theme is already crowded (z=1.18), and broad eligible breadth means rotation capital has many alternatives.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms ZEB.TO by more than 5% before the check-by date.
